opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members who are submitting or presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Supports Society members to attend Society‑sponsored meetings and conferences by covering registration, travel and accommodation costs.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow; open to Society members who wish to host events at their organisation.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for Society Representatives and members to host internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who need additional support to achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Supports postdoctoral researchers with consumables, training, and other costs (excluding salary) to advance their research and impact.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Society members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research in physiology.
opportunities.summary: Supports the creation of novel physiology teaching resources or educational research projects.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members conducting physiological pilot studies, technique development, or knowledge‑transfer activities.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for pilot studies, new techniques, or activities that promote knowledge transfer and impact in physiology.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full or Fellow members in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion within physiological science teaching or research.
